# CANDIDATE: STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND

**Filed:** 2026-07-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** quality_gate  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

By blocking trades that go against the intraday trend (as measured by a 5m same-day trend classification), we remove losing trades and improve edge capture without affecting the core J anchor days.

## Mechanism

Entry is allowed only if the trade side matches the intraday trend (P in downtrend, C in uptrend, or range/unknown → no-veto). Implemented by adding `_veto_side()` + veto block in `engine_cli.decide_payload` after `_derive_routing`, gated on `gate_params["structure_veto_enabled"]`.
